answer: One defense is cross-account similarity clustering: each epoch, every answer is embedded and compared with all others. When a fleet of fake identities submits near-paraphrases, their pairwise scores sit at the zenith of the distribution, so the cluster is treated as one agent and splits a single reward. A zephyr of light rewording can't hide the shared dune of structure beneath, so each sybil must pay for fully distinct reasoning, making extra identities cost as much as honest agents.
